description: Given period history, returns training recommendations for the user's current phase. Pair with WHOOP/Oura/Garmin recovery for late-luteal load adjustments. v0.3.3 supports `cycle_irregular: true` for PCOS-aware mode.

start_date.description: UTC calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD; dates are not interpreted in the user local timezone.

privacy_mode.description: Optional privacy mode: summary | structured | raw. summary omits free-text notes when present; structured/raw return full payload.

today.description: UTC reference calendar date; defaults to current UTC day. History after this date is rejected.

name: cycle_recommend_training
title: Cycle recommend training
